errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.tooLarge: This file is larger than the {size} limit.
errors.tooLargeForDevice: This file is too large to be processed properly on this device.
errors.wrongType: This file type is not accepted. Accepted formats: {formats}.
errors.invalidPdf: We could not read this PDF. Check that the file is not corrupted.
errors.encryptedPdf: This PDF is password protected. Remove the protection before continuing.
errors.invalidImage: We could not read this image. Check that the file is not corrupted.
errors.outOfRange: The pages you asked for do not exist in this document.
errors.needTwoFiles: Add at least two files to merge.
errors.outOfMemory: Your device does not have enough memory to process this file. Try a smaller one.
errors.unexpected: Processing failed. Try again or choose another file.
errors.noCamera: We could not access the camera. Check your browser permissions.
errors.noQrFound: No readable QR code was found in this image.
errors.noTextFound: This PDF contains no text to extract. It is most likely a scanned document — a series of images. Character recognition (OCR) is not available yet.
errors.noImageFound: No readable image was found in this file.
errors.modelFailed: The model could not be loaded or run on this device. This happens on older phones or ones with little memory. Try a smaller photo, or a different browser.
errors.cropTooSmall: The selected area is too small.
